title: Event-Centric Human Value Understanding in News-Domain Texts: An Actor-Conditioned, Multi-Granularity Benchmark
reasoning: The paper introduces NEVU, a benchmark for human value understanding. The value taxonomy used (Level-1 values) explicitly includes ethical and religious categories such as 'Be just', 'Universalism', and 'Tradition' (which includes 'Be holding religious faith' and 'Be respecting traditions'). It evaluates models on their ability to infer these values from news text, including specific case studies related to religious faith and moral responsibility.
